Three dimensions, as the acceptance criteria of the MoU (section 8.1).

## Technical readiness, Technical Team
- [ ] Runs the OntoPortal upstream code; fork accessible to the Technical Team
- [ ] Functional validation of the portal passed: <link to the functional portal validation issue>
- [ ] EOSC Federated Capabilities (SSO with EOSC AAI, helpdesk, monitoring), or a compliance plan
- [ ] Federation accounts and API keys exchanged with the other portals
- [ ] Portal added to the federation configuration of the other portals

Checked by: @… on <date>

## Editorial, Editorial Board
- [ ] Actively participating in the Editorial Board
- [ ] OntoPortal Federation metadata guidelines mostly followed on most of the ontologies
- [ ] Canonical portal agreed for each ontology shared with another portal

Checked by: @… on <date>

## Governance, Coordination Committee
- [ ] Strategic alignment: thematic scope fits the Federation
- [ ] MoU signed by the institution
- [ ] Representatives nominated to the Coordination Committee, the Technical Team and the Editorial Board
- [ ] Portal shown as a Federation member on ontoportal.org

Decided by: @… on <date>
